mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, p.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, p.status AS status, COALESCE(rc.report_count, 0) AS report_count, COALESCE(rc.spam_count, 0) AS spam_count, COALESCE(rc.abuse_count, 0) AS abuse_count, COALESCE(rc.illegal_camping_count, 0) AS illegal_camping_count, COALESCE(rc.privacy_count, 0) AS privacy_count, COALESCE(rc.money_scam_count, 0) AS money_scam_count, COALESCE(rc.other_count, 0) AS other_count, p.updated_at AS status_changed_at FROM community_post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.target_id AS target_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'SPAM' THEN 1 END) AS spam_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'ABUSE' THEN 1 END) AS abuse_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'ILLEGAL_CAMPING' THEN 1 END) AS illegal_camping_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'PRIVACY' THEN 1 END) AS privacy_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'MONEY_SCAM' THEN 1 END) AS money_scam_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'OTHER' THEN 1 END) AS other_count FROM community_report r WHERE r.target_type = 'POST' AND r.reviewed_at IS NULL GROUP BY r.target_id ) rc ON rc.target_id = p.id WHERE p.status = #{status} ORDER BY (COALESCE(rc.money_scam_count, 0) > 0) DESC, p.updated_at ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.id AS comment_id, c.post_id AS post_id, c.content AS content, c.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, c.status AS status, COALESCE(rc.report_count, 0) AS report_count, COALESCE(rc.spam_count, 0) AS spam_count, COALESCE(rc.abuse_count, 0) AS abuse_count, COALESCE(rc.illegal_camping_count, 0) AS illegal_camping_count, COALESCE(rc.privacy_count, 0) AS privacy_count, COALESCE(rc.money_scam_count, 0) AS money_scam_count, COALESCE(rc.other_count, 0) AS other_count, c.updated_at AS status_changed_at FROM community_comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.target_id AS target_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'SPAM' THEN 1 END) AS spam_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'ABUSE' THEN 1 END) AS abuse_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'ILLEGAL_CAMPING' THEN 1 END) AS illegal_camping_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'PRIVACY' THEN 1 END) AS privacy_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'MONEY_SCAM' THEN 1 END) AS money_scam_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'OTHER' THEN 1 END) AS other_count FROM community_report r WHERE r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND r.reviewed_at IS NULL GROUP BY r.target_id ) rc ON rc.target_id = c.id WHERE c.status = #{status} ORDER BY (COALESCE(rc.money_scam_count, 0) > 0) DESC, c.updated_at ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
